== Trivia == *Shortly after the event started, the NPC was disabled on the main network but not on the Alpha Network. On the Alpha Network, there was a bug that allowed players to get multiple hats by switching hubs. All hats claimed by each player were always the same color, regardless of network. A few minutes after the event started, the NPC on the main server was enabled for a few minutes with the same bug, but it was disabled again after a few more minutes. The bug was fixed on the alpha network after just over 20 minutes, and the fix was pushed to the main network about 60 minutes later. Players who claimed a Balloon Hat during the bug were able to claim another when the NPC was enabled after the bug was fixed. *If player equips more than one Balloon Hat, only one of them will give stat bonus, resulting in only {{Green|+1}} {{stat|mf}} bonus. *Hatcessories are inconsistent with their names. The 2022 Crab Hats are the only Hatcessories specifying their year of origin in their title. Crab Hats and Sloth Hats are said to be "of Celebration", while the Balloon Hats are "Anniversary". == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2024/June 10|[[File:Red 5th Anniversary Balloon Hat.png|26px]] Added '''5th Anniversary Balloon Hat'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Accessories}} {{Nav/Armors}}
